**Kruskal**: edges ko weight ke increasing order me lo; jo edge cycle na banaye use add karo. **Prim**: ek vertex se start karo, har baar tree se bahar jaane wali sabse sasti edge add karo.

example.problem: Undirected weighted graph: A–B (4), A–C (1), C–B (2), B–D (1), C–D (5). A se Dijkstra chala kar har vertex ki shortest distance nikalo.
steps: Start: d(A) = 0, baaki sab ∞.
A finalize: d(B) = 4, d(C) = 1.
Sabse chhota unvisited C (1) finalize: B via C = 1 + 2 = 3 < 4, to d(B) = 3; D via C = 1 + 5 = 6.
Ab B (3) finalize: D via B = 3 + 1 = 4 < 6, to d(D) = 4.
D (4) finalize. Sab vertices done.
Answer: d(A) = 0, d(C) = **1**, d(B) = **3**, d(D) = **4**; A se D ka path A → C → B → D.

mistakes: Dijkstra me direct edge ko hi final maan lena. A–B ka direct weight 4 tha, par A → C → B sirf 3 hai — har step pe update karo.
Kruskal me cycle check bhool jaana. Sasti edge bhi skip karni padti hai agar wo already connected do vertices ko jodti ho.
Spanning tree me n edges lena. n vertices ke tree me hamesha n − 1 edges hoti hain.
revision: Tree with n vertices ⇒ n − 1 edges.
Bellman-Ford: negative edges OK, negative cycle detect karta hai.
Kruskal: sort edges, add if no cycle.
Prim: grow tree with cheapest outgoing edge.

questions.question: 10 vertices wale kisi bhi tree me kitni edges hoti hain?
questions.explanation: n vertices ke tree me n − 1 edges: 10 − 1 = 9. Ek bhi extra edge cycle bana degi. 45 to complete graph K₁₀ ki edges hain.

questions.question: Dijkstra's algorithm kab galat answer de sakta hai?
options: Jab graph me negative edge weights hon
questions.explanation: Dijkstra ek vertex ko finalize karne ke baad dobara update nahi karta, ye maan kar ki aage ka path sirf lamba hoga. Negative edge ye assumption tod deti hai. Cycles aur undirected graphs me Dijkstra theek kaam karta hai.

questions.question: Undirected weighted graph: S–A (2), S–B (6), A–B (3), A–C (7), B–C (1). S se C ki shortest distance kya hai?
questions.explanation: Dijkstra: d(A) = 2; A se B = 2 + 3 = 5 (< 6); B se C = 5 + 1 = 6; A se C direct = 9. Shortest S → A → B → C = 6. 7 = S → B → C, aur 9 = S → A → C — sirf obvious raaste dekhna trap hai.

questions.question: Graph ki edges: P–Q (1), Q–R (2), P–R (3), R–S (4), Q–S (5), P–S (6). Minimum spanning tree ka total weight kya hai?
questions.explanation: Kruskal: P–Q (1) add, Q–R (2) add, P–R (3) cycle P-Q-R banati hai to skip, R–S (4) add. 4 vertices ke liye 3 edges ho gayi: 1 + 2 + 4 = 7. 10 tab aata hai jab cycle wali edge (3) bhi le lete ho.

questions.question: Kruskal's algorithm kisi edge ko kab skip karta hai?
options: Jab wo edge already chuni hui edges ke saath cycle banaye
Jab uska weight sabse zyada ho
Jab wo kisi naye vertex ko tree se jode
questions.explanation: Kruskal edges ko sasti se mehngi order me dekhta hai aur sirf wahi edge skip karta hai jo cycle bana de. Heavy edge bhi le li jaati hai agar wo do alag components ko jodti ho — sirf weight dekh kar skip karna galat hai.

questions.question: Undirected graph: A–B (3), A–C (1), B–C (7), B–D (5), C–D (2), D–E (4), C–E (6). Prim's algorithm A se start kare to edges kis order me add hongi?
questions.explanation: Tree {A}: sasti edge A–C (1). {A, C}: options A–B 3, C–D 2, C–E 6, C–B 7 → C–D (2). {A, C, D}: A–B 3, D–E 4, D–B 5 → A–B (3). Phir D–E (4). MST weight 10. Doosra option trap hai — Prim sirf A ki edges nahi, poore tree se bahar jaane wali sabse sasti edge leta hai.

questions.question: Ek connected graph me 8 vertices aur 12 edges hain. Spanning tree banane ke liye kam se kam kitni edges hatani padengi?
questions.explanation: 8 vertices ke tree me exactly 8 − 1 = 7 edges hoti hain. To 12 − 7 = 5 edges hatani hongi (har hataayi edge ek cycle todti hai). 4 = 12 − 8 tab aata hai jab tree me n edges maan lete ho. 7 to spanning tree me bachi edges ki count hai, hataayi gayi ki nahi.

questions.question: Weighted graph me saare vertex pairs ke beech shortest paths ek saath nikalne ke liye kaunsa algorithm bana hai?
questions.explanation: Floyd-Warshall saare pairs ki shortest distances ek saath, roughly n³ steps me nikalta hai. Kruskal aur Prim minimum spanning tree banate hain, shortest paths nahi — MST me do vertices ke beech ka path shortest ho, ye zaroori nahi. BFS sirf unweighted graph me minimum edges wala path deta hai.

questions.question: Ek connected weighted undirected graph par Prim aur Kruskal dono chalaye gaye. Unke diye MSTs ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Prim ka MST hamesha halka hota hai
Kaunsa halka aayega, ye Prim ke start vertex par depend karta hai
Kruskal ka MST hamesha halka hota hai
Dono ka total weight hamesha same hota hai
questions.explanation: Dono algorithms ek minimum spanning tree dete hain, aur minimum weight ek hi number hai — isliye total weight hamesha same. Equal weights wali edges hon to dono alag-alag edges chun sakte hain (tree alag ho sakta hai), par weight nahi badalta. Prim ka start vertex sirf edges add hone ka order badalta hai, final weight nahi.

questions.question: Directed weighted graph ki edges: S → A (4), S → B (1), B → A (2), A → C (1), B → C (5), C → D (3), A → D (6). S se D ki shortest distance kya hai?
questions.explanation: Dijkstra: d(S) = 0; S se d(B) = 1, d(A) = 4. B finalize: d(A) = min(4, 1 + 2) = 3, d(C) = 6. A finalize (3): d(C) = min(6, 3 + 1) = 4, d(D) = 9. C finalize (4): d(D) = min(9, 4 + 3) = 7. Path S → B → A → C → D = 1 + 2 + 1 + 3 = 7. 8 = S → A → C → D (direct S → A ko final maan liya), aur 9 = S → B → C → D ya S → B → A → D.

questions.question: Ek connected undirected simple graph me 9 vertices aur 9 edges hain. Iske baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Graph me koi cycle nahi hai
Graph me exactly ek cycle hai
questions.explanation: Connected graph ka spanning tree 9 − 1 = 8 edges ka hota hai. Graph me ek edge extra hai, aur tree me ek edge jodne se exactly ek cycle banti hai. Isliye exactly ek cycle. 'Koi cycle nahi' sirf 8 edges (tree) par sach hota. Graph possible bhi hai, jaise 9 vertices ki ek cycle.

questions.question: Undirected weighted graph: A–B (2), A–C (5), B–C (1), B–D (4), C–D (1), D–E (3), C–E (6). A se E ki shortest distance aur path kya hai?
questions.explanation: Dijkstra A se: d(B) = 2, d(C) = min(5, 2 + 1) = 3, d(D) = min(2 + 4, 3 + 1) = 4, d(E) = min(3 + 6, 4 + 3) = 7. Path A → B → C → D → E = 2 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 7 — zyada edges, par kam weight. A → B → D → E aur A → B → C → E dono 9 dete hain; kam edges wala raasta dekh kar ruk jaana trap hai. A → C → E = 11 sirf direct edges hain.

questions.question: Graph ki edges: P–Q (2), P–R (3), Q–R (2), Q–S (4), R–S (4), R–T (5), S–T (1), Q–T (6). Minimum spanning tree ka total weight kya hai?
questions.explanation: Kruskal (weight order): S–T (1) add; P–Q (2) add; Q–R (2) add; P–R (3) cycle P-Q-R banati hai, skip; Q–S (4) add — ab {P, Q, R} aur {S, T} jud gaye. 5 vertices ke liye 4 edges ho gayi: 1 + 2 + 2 + 4 = 9. R–S (4) bhi weight 4 ki hai, par ab wo cycle banati — tie me koi bhi ek lo, weight 9 hi rehta hai. 12 tab aata hai jab P–R (3) ko cycle check ke bina le lete ho, aur 10 = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 me sasti Q–R (2) ki jagah P–R (3) le li.

questions.question: Directed weighted graph ki edges: S → A (2), S → B (4), B → A (−3), A → C (3), B → C (4), C → D (2), A → D (6). Ek edge negative hai, par koi negative cycle nahi hai. S se D ki sahi shortest distance kya hai, aur kis path se?
options: Defined nahi hai, kyunki graph me negative edge hai
questions.explanation: Negative edge hai, to Bellman-Ford ki tarah har raasta check karo (order S, B, A, C, D me): d(B) = 4, d(A) = min(2, 4 + (−3)) = 1, d(C) = min(1 + 3, 4 + 4) = 4, d(D) = min(4 + 2, 1 + 6) = 6. Path S → B → A → C → D = 4 − 3 + 3 + 2 = 6. 7 = S → A → C → D — ye tab aata hai jab d(A) = 2 ko jaldi final maan lo (negative edge par Dijkstra wala trap). 8 = S → A → D. Shortest distance tabhi undefined hoti hai jab negative cycle ho; yahan koi cycle hi nahi hai.

questions.question: Undirected graph ki edges: A–B (3), B–C (4), A–C (x), C–D (2), B–D (6), jahan x > 0. x ki kis value ke liye minimum spanning tree ka total weight exactly 8 hoga?
questions.explanation: 4 vertices ke MST me 3 edges. C–D (2) aur A–B (3) hamesha aati hain (sabse sasti, koi cycle nahi). Teesri edge C ko {A, B} se jodti hai: A–C (x) ya B–C (4), jo sasti ho. To MST weight = 2 + 3 + min(x, 4). Ye 8 tab hoga jab min(x, 4) = 3, yaani x = 3. x = 2 par weight 7, aur x = 4 ya 5 par B–C (4) se weight 9 hi rehta hai — x ≥ 4 hone par x ka effect hi khatam ho jaata hai.
